paragraphs: I'm Swar, a 20-year-old developer from Navi Mumbai. I build full-stack MERN apps that look good and hold up under real users.

I like shipping things people actually use. A 3D space dashboard I worked on placed Top 8 among 100+ hackathon entries, and a college management system I helped build has 500+ registered students. If something goes on a screen, I want it to look like someone cared.
I also teach. I've run version control workshops for my college peers and I stream on YouTube. Explaining something is the quickest way to find out whether you really understand it.
Away from the keyboard, you'll find me riding my bike, losing at chess, planning the next hackathon, or cooking something that (mostly) turns out fine.
